keyFindings.finding: Worldwide revenue increased 48% driven by a 60% increase in product volume, partially offset by a 13% decrease in realized net prices.
keyFindings.implication: Demonstrates unprecedented volume scaling that overwhelms modest unit price concession.

keyFindings.finding: Acquired IPR&D expense totaled $2.80 billion ($3.03 per share) resulting from acquisitions of Orna, Ajax, Centessa, and Kelonia.
keyFindings.implication: Depressed headline GAAP/Non-GAAP quarterly earnings, but represents non-recurring upfront R&D investments.

keyFindings.finding: Parenteral manufacturing capital commitments expanded by an incremental $5.3 billion across domestic and European facilities.
keyFindings.implication: Reinforces multi-year capital moat against competitors facing syringe assembly constraints.

keyFindings.finding: Explicit risk disclosure on potential adverse health events arising from unapproved compounded GLP-1 products harming the overall incretin class safety reputation.
keyFindings.implication: Heightens legal and regulatory imperative to ban compounding pharmacies.
